title: One Coverage per Source Job: Workmanship Warranties Desk Guidance
content:
**Rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a source repair order, glass job or calibration order carries at most the number of coverages the plan allows per delivered or completed source job. No coverage already exists for the same source work. A concern on a vehicle with several coverages is handled under the coverage whose source work it concerns; a concern in an area no coverage's source work touched is outside the repaired area for all of them.

## Condition for issuing a coverage

The condition is that no coverage already exists for the same source work. It is judged on the company's records, not on what the customer says, before the coverage is issued:

- **Object.** The source work is identified by its own reference: the insurance claim repair order, the customer-pay repair order, the glass job or the calibration order on which a coverage would be issued.
- **What counts as an existing coverage.** Any coverage already on file for that same source reference counts, whatever its status: active, redeemed, expired, voided or ended by sale.

| Records show for the same source reference | Condition |
|---|---|
| No coverage on file | met |
| An active coverage | not met |
| A coverage that is redeemed, expired, voided or ended by sale | not met |

## Which coverage a concern belongs to

When one vehicle carries several coverages, each concern is handled under the coverage whose source work it concerns. A concern in an area that no coverage's source work touched is outside the repaired area for every one of those coverages.

## Hypothetical cases

1. A vehicle carries a Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty from a windshield job and a Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty from a dent repair on the left front door. Peeling paint on the left front door concerns the dent repair's source work and is handled under the Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty.
2. On the same vehicle, a concern on the rear bumper, which neither the windshield job nor the door repair touched, is outside the repaired area for both coverages.
3. A completed calibration order already has an expired Calibration Workmanship Warranty on file. A second coverage on that order does not meet the condition, because an existing coverage counts whatever its status.
